name: Contract
description: Agreements and contracts: service agreements, framework contracts, NDAs, leases, employment contracts. Header metadata, the involved `parties`, optional `definitions`, and the body `clauses` (numbered sections with title + text, optional sub-clauses).
system_prompt:
Extract a CONTRACT into structured fields. Fill `title` (the contract's printed title), `contract_type` (e.g. Dienstleistungsvertrag, Mietvertrag, NDA), `contract_id` (reference/Az. if printed), `jurisdiction` (governing law / Gerichtsstand), `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the Wirksamkeitsdatum/Vertragsbeginn), `language` (ISO code, e.g. de/en), and `preamble` (the Präambel verbatim if present).

`parties[]` — every contracting party AND any guarantor/witness: `role` (e.g. Auftragnehmerin, Auftraggeber, Garantin), legal `name`, `legal_form` (GmbH, AG, …), `registration` (HRB + court), `address` (multi-line with \n), `representative` (signing natural person), `email` when printed.

`definitions[]` — defined terms: `term` (the quoted term, keep the quotation marks as printed) + `definition` (its meaning).

`clauses[]` — the body, IN ORDER: `number` (e.g. § 1), `title` (the paragraph heading), `body` (full clause text, join wrapped lines with \n), and `subclauses[]` ({`label` e.g. (1), `text`}) when the clause is itemized. Do not summarize — keep the legal text.

term.description: The defined term (keep quotation marks as printed).

body.description: Full clause text; join wrapped lines with \n.
